reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and consistent with that status the proposal contains no redline and no counterparty comment — the rendered text is identical to the originals, so there is no invalid or directionally wrong edit to reject.

The cited paragraphs support the compliance call: Article IV (p0049) only preserves Licensor's right to payment for trades actually performed (no acceleration or minimum-fee-on-termination), and Article XXIII (p0142) expressly bars termination damages against either party, which favours Customer under this rule.

The near-miss items are correctly triaged as outside rule LD: the >5% audit cost-shift (p0064) is ordinary audit cost allocation, and the p0070 floor is volume-based consideration rather than a stipulated damages amount; both are properly deferred to the audit and payment-terms rules.
No deterministic check failures, and the rationale accurately characterises the quoted text, so the finding is sound internal evidence of compliance rather than a negotiation issue.
